title: Your Apps Are Engineered to Steal $840/Year From You
hook: Your most-used apps were deliberately built to confuse you into spending money — and the average smartphone user loses $840 a year to tricks that were illegal in Europe by 2023.
angle: Dark patterns are real, documented, and EU-banned — naming three specific tricks with names (auto-upgrade, confirm shaming, impossible unsubscribe) makes it actionable; the $840 annual cost makes the stakes visceral
audience: Any smartphone user with subscriptions — statistically everyone under 50
key_numbers: $840 — average annual losses from dark patterns on mobile
95% — share of top apps using at least one dark pattern
$24 billion — what dark patterns extract from U.S. consumers annually
73% — free trial users who get auto-charged without meaning to
2023 — year the EU banned the worst dark patterns
